subject.title: fix(telegram): Mini App hangs on Opening dashboard when auth never responds

question: Should Telegram Mini App authentication use the proposed fixed 15-second deadline, accepting that slower valid requests will enter the expired/retry flow?
rationale: Source and proof establish that a deadline is needed, but repository evidence does not define the acceptable authentication latency or whether 15 seconds is the intended user contract.

options.title: Accept the 15-second deadline
options.body: Merge the bounded recovery behavior because it replaces an indefinite hang with a clear retry path while allowing substantial normal network latency.

options.title: Select another fixed deadline
options.body: Adjust the constant and corresponding proof if Telegram owners expect valid authentication to exceed 15 seconds in supported deployments.

recommendation.title: Accept the 15-second deadline
recommendation.body: Merge the bounded recovery behavior because it replaces an indefinite hang with a clear retry path while allowing substantial normal network latency.
